what: FINAL COMMITTED RECOMMENDATION (agent-verified + E2E-validated, 2026-04-21): Option B — Minified JS on npm. IMPLEMENTED + VALIDATED on branch feature/minified-publish (commits d30f617, 25d21b8, 27f2074, f51a595). Branched from feature/phase-1@71f8a9b. Build pipeline: tsc produces dist/ for dev/tests (unchanged), esbuild --bundle --minify produces THREE distinct bundled outputs (critical — each covers a separate entry point): (1) dist/cli/aide-memory.js (118 KB) — CLI entry, bin field target; (2) dist/memory/index.js (703 KB) — library entry, main field, imported by hook helpers; (3) dist/memory/cli.js (618 KB) — MCP server stdio entry, spawned by .mcp.json generated by `aide-memory init`. MISSING any one of the three causes breakage: no CLI bundle = binary broken; no lib bundle = hook helpers break; no MCP bundle = `aide-memory` MCP server fails to start silently after install. Externals: better-sqlite3 (native N-API), @huggingface/transformers (optional dynamic-imported). Bundled: commander, chalk, fast-glob, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, zod. Hook helpers updated to require('dist/memory/index') instead of individual store/recall files. package.aide-memory.json files allowlist: dist/cli/aide-memory.js, dist/memory/index.js, dist/memory/cli.js, scripts/hooks/*.sh, scripts/hooks/*.js, scripts/hooks/defaults.json, src/templates/rules, README.md, LICENSE. scripts/verify-package.sh fails on any .ts/.map/src-leak OR missing bundle. .npmignore belt-and-suspenders. All 654 tests pass. **E2E VALIDATION PASSED** (docs/VALIDATION_MINIFIED_PUBLISH.md): tarball built, installed in scratch project, exercised 18 CLI commands + 7 MCP tools via JSON-RPC + 11 hook scripts with representative stdin. Zero source leakage verified. **IMPORTANT: aide-memory@0.2.0 is already LIVE on npm** (published 2026-04-11, stale). Next version must bump past 0.2.0 — recommended 0.3.0 (breaking via --scan removal). Version + release notes deferred to publishing agent per user. Unpublish policy CORRECTED: CLI unpublish works after 72h if no reverse deps + <300 weekly downloads + single maintainer (see memory 161 + docs/HANDOFF_MINIFIED_PUBLISH.md). Handoff doc: docs/HANDOFF_MINIFIED_PUBLISH.md. Permanent release guide: docs/RELEASING.md. Guardrails: don't re-add bundled deps to dependencies field, don't loosen files allowlist, don't skip verify-package.sh, don't drop dist/memory/cli.js from the bundle set (MCP would break silently).
why: Post-validation update capturing (a) the critical three-entry bundle architecture (CLI + library + MCP server — missing any breaks a user path), (b) validation-passed state, (c) links to handoff + release guide, (d) corrected unpublish policy. Prior version of memory only mentioned two bundles; missing the MCP entry was a real bug caught during validation.
